sources.title: CIIL · Kui language collection
sources.note: CIIL classifies Kui as South-Central Dravidian and relates it to Kuvi and Gondi. Its community population figures are not adopted as language-speaker counts.

sources.title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Odisha — 2011
sources.note: Original C-16 workbook, Sheet1, row 226: individual Kui entry 070001, 939,177 people in Odisha. District counts use that same entry. These are reported mother tongues in 2011, not current speaker or ethnic-community totals.
